byline: Presented by Nosheen Iqbal with Sam Jones and Ashifa Kassam; produced by Tom Glasser, George McDonagh, Natalie Ktena and Ross Burns; executive producer Sami Kent

blocks.text:
Madrid correspondent Sam Jones and European community affairs correspondent Ashifa Kassam report on a pivotal election in Spain this weekend, which could see longtime PM Pedro Sánchez replaced by a conservative coalition including the far right

He has become an icon of the European left. A great political survivor, Spain’s Pedro Sánchez has been in power for eight years while – across the continent – the right has been on the march.

The Socialist party leader has championed immigration, stood up to Donald Trump and been a notable voice for Palestinians in Gaza.
